evidence.title: Gumloop: Build AI agents for work
Gumloop Community Templates | AI Agent and Workflow Automation Templates

name: Gumloop
summary: Multiplayer AI agent builder: teams build agents on any model with 400+ connectors, triggers and skills.
description: Teams describe work in plain language and get agents that read and write company apps, run on triggers, reuse skills they write and share, and produce artifacts such as dashboards, documents, spreadsheets and web apps. Agents get a real browser with saved logins and CAPTCHA handling. Model-agnostic, with enterprise controls (SSO, audit logging, usage monitoring, VPC deployments), a REST API and an MCP server.
contains: Agents built in plain language with any AI model
Triggers, Skills and Artifacts (web apps, docs, spreadsheets, images)
Real browser with saved logins, CAPTCHA handling and session recordings
Enterprise: SSO, audit logs, usage monitoring, VPC deployment
REST API at api.gumloop.com plus an MCP server; CLI and Chrome extension
